name: best-american-diagnostic-web
description: Website proposal for Best American Diagnostic Center (Hialeah, FL) — static, bilingual, dependency-free.

scripts.shot: node tools/shot.js index.html services.html patients.html providers.html about.html contact.html proposal.html
scripts.test: npm run audit && npm run check && npm run check:buttons && npm run check:images && npm run check:responsive
scripts.photos:art: python3 tools/make_photos.py && node tools/render_photos.js && python3 tools/fetch_photos.py --local && python3 tools/build.py
